description: This Kotlin source file defines an abstract RecyclerView adapter class 'ExtendedListAdapter' with selection management features, including saving/restoring selection state, handling item selection toggling, and integrating with Android lifecycle components. It also includes an interface for selectable view holders and an extension property for back navigation handling within a fragment.

classes.name: SelectableViewHolder
classes.description: Interface for view holders that can reflect selection status changes.

classes.name: ExtendedListAdapter
classes.description: An abstract RecyclerView ListAdapter with support for item selection, state saving, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: enableSelection
methods.description: Enables selection mode, restores saved selection state, and sets up lifecycle observers.

methods.name: setOnListChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for when the list data changes.

methods.name: getItemAtPosition
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified position.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns a list of currently selected items.

methods.name: toggleSelectionForItem
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of an item by its ID.

methods.name: getPositionById
methods.description: Finds the position of an item by its ID.

methods.name: onItemSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the selection visual state of a view holder.

methods.name: saveSelectedIds
methods.description: Saves the current selection state to the saved state registry.

methods.name: updateSelectedIds
methods.description: Updates the internal list of selected IDs based on the current list.

methods.name: onSelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles actions when selection state changes, including saving state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: onCurrentListChanged
methods.description: Overrides ListAdapter method to update selection state when the list changes.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds view holder and updates selection status if selection mode is enabled.

methods.name: onAttachedToRecyclerView
methods.description: Stores reference to RecyclerView when attached.

methods.name: releaseReferences
methods.description: Releases references to avoid memory leaks.
